# Cncf Alibaba Cloud Kcsp Reviewer

Review Alibaba Cloud (KCSP) using its official documentation and repository in the Special / Kubernetes Certified Service Provider category. Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes is a fully-managed service compatible with Kubernetes to help users focus on their  applications rather than managing container infrastructure.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
